subject: Animation
title: Encanto and Musical Innovation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Encanto and Musical Innovation.

hook.text: In 2021, Disney released Encanto, a film set in Colombia about a family with magical gifts.

buildup.text: Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote songs blending Latin American rhythms with Broadway storytelling.

discovery.text: We Don't Talk About Bruno exploded on social media and outperformed the film's official single.

twist.text: Bruno's viral success caught Disney off guard. The studio had promoted a different song entirely.

climax.text: Encanto showed that audiences, not marketing departments, now decide which moments become hits.

punchline.text: A song Disney did not promote became its biggest hit.

quiz.question: What unexpected thing happened with Encanto's music?
options: The film had no songs at all
We Don't Talk About Bruno went viral despite Disney promoting a different song as the lead single
Lin-Manuel Miranda refused to write songs
